frictions.description: WebSocket frame capture for snapshot/protocol data was not possible because no CLI WebSocket tools (websocat, wscat) are installed, and the browser WebSocket interceptor couldn't be installed before the initial connection. Evidence for VAL-EXPLORE-08 protocol field verification relies on DOM inspection rather than raw WebSocket payload.
frictions.resolution: Used JavaScript eval to read rendered DOM content from the Inspector panel, confirming obligation title, description, scopeLabel, and Focus related nodes button are all present.

frictions.description: Page reload was needed to install WebSocket interceptor, but this caused Vite HMR WebSocket warnings. These are not application errors.
frictions.resolution: Identified the warnings as Vite HMR-related (ws://localhost:5173/ws), not the app's bayesgrove WebSocket (ws://127.0.0.1:3100/ws). Confirmed app WebSocket reconnected successfully.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 3 passed. VAL-EXPLORE-07: HMC diagnostics (291 divergences, E-BFMI warning) clearly visible in REPL output after bg_run execution. VAL-EXPLORE-08: Protocol obligation 'Review computation validity' surfaced in Inspector with title, description, PROJECT scope, and Focus related nodes button. 2 related actions also appeared. VAL-EXPLORE-09: Zero uncaught JavaScript errors throughout workflow. Server remained healthy (health check returned 200). No crashes.
